title: Protocol for the Preparation of a Recombinant Treacle Fragment for LLPS Assays
author: Nadezhda V. Petrova

steps.title: Make LB agar plates (+ampicillin, glucose)
steps.instruction: Prepare 1.5 % (w/v) agar LB plates with 100 µg/mL ampicillin and 0.5 % (w/v) glucose.

substeps.instruction: Weigh Triptone 2 g, Yeast extract 1 g, NaCl 2 g, Agar 3 g and add to 200 mL dH₂O.
Add 67 µL 5 M NaOH to adjust pH 7.0, autoclave 121 °C 20 min.
Cool to ~50 °C, add 2 mL 1000× Ampicillin (100 µg/mL) and 0.5 % glucose (add 0.5 % of 40 % stock).
Pour 25–35 mL into 85 mm petri dishes, let harden, store 4 °C ≤1 month or RT ≤1 week.

steps.title: Make LB agar plates (no antibiotic)
steps.instruction: Prepare 1.5 % (w/v) agar LB plates without antibiotic.

substeps.instruction: Same composition as above but omit ampicillin.
Autoclave, cool to 50 °C, pour, harden, store 4 °C ≤2 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare 10× Phosphate buffer
steps.instruction: Make 1 L of 10× phosphate buffer (720 mM K₂HPO₄·3H₂O, 170 mM KH₂PO₄, 5 mM MgSO₄).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 125 g K₂HPO₄·3H₂O, 23 g KH₂PO₄, 5 mM MgSO₄ (5 mL 1 M stock) in 90 mL dH₂O.
Autoclave 121 °C 20 min, filter‑sterilize, store at RT.

steps.title: Make 1× Phosphate buffer
steps.instruction: Dilute 10× phosphate buffer 1:10 with dH₂O to obtain 1 L of 1× buffer.

substeps.instruction: Mix 100 mL 10× buffer with 900 mL dH₂O.

steps.title: Prepare Terrific Broth medium
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 L Terrific Broth (12 g Triptone, 24 g Yeast extract, 5 mL glycerol).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve reagents in 995 mL dH₂O, autoclave 121 °C 15 min, store RT.

steps.title: Prepare TB buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 50 mL TB buffer (10 mM PIPES pH 7.5, 15 mM CaCl₂, 5 mM KCl, 55 mM MnCl₂).

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL 250 mM PIPES, 0.5 mL 1.5 M CaCl₂, 1 mL 2.5 M KCl, 2.75 mL 1 M MnCl₂, bring to 50 mL with dH₂O.
Filter‑sterilize (0.22 µm), store 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Start buffer
steps.instruction: Make 200 mL Start buffer (20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 10 mM MgCl₂, 0.1 % NP40, 10 % glycerol).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 4 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 7.5 mL 4 M NaCl, 2 mL 1 M MgCl₂, 1 mL 20 % NP40, 20 mL glycerol, add dH₂O to 200 mL.
Add fresh before use: 200 µL 1 M DTT (1 mM final), 2 mL 100× protease inhibitor, 2 mL 100× phosphatase inhibitor.
Store 4 °C up to 6 months.

steps.title: Prepare Wash buffer
steps.instruction: Make 200 mL Wash buffer (20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 500 mM NaCl, 10 mM MgCl₂, 0.1 % NP40, 10 % glycerol).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 4 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 25 mL 4 M NaCl, 2 mL 1 M MgCl₂, 1 mL 20 % NP40, 20 mL glycerol, bring to 200 mL with dH₂O.
Add 200 µL 1 M DTT (1 mM final) just before use, store 4 °C ≤6 months.

steps.title: Prepare Maltose elution buffer
steps.instruction: Make 200 mL elution buffer with maltose (20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 200 mM NaCl, 40 mM maltose).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 4 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 4 mL 4 M NaCl, 10 mL 0.5 M maltose, add dH₂O to 200 mL.
Add 200 µL 1 M DTT (1 mM final) before use, store 4 °C ≤6 months.

steps.title: Prepare maltose‑free elution buffer
steps.instruction: Make 200 mL elution buffer without maltose (20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 200 mM NaCl).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 4 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 4 mL 4 M NaCl, add dH₂O to 200 mL.
Add 200 µL 1 M DTT (1 mM final) before use, store 4 °C ≤6 months.

steps.title: Prepare Buffer A
steps.instruction: Make 200 mL Buffer A (20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 4 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, add dH₂O to 200 mL.
Add 200 µL 1 M DTT (1 mM final) before use.

steps.title: Prepare Buffer B
steps.instruction: Make 200 mL Buffer B (20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 500 mM NaCl).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 4 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 25 mL 4 M NaCl, add dH₂O to 200 mL.
Add 200 µL 1 M DTT (1 mM final) before use.

steps.title: Prepare 250 mM PIPES pH 7.5
steps.instruction: Dissolve 3.78 g PIPES in 50 mL, adjust to pH 7.5 with 5 M NaOH (≈3.5 mL), filter‑sterilize, store 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5
steps.instruction: Dissolve 24.22 g Tris base, bring to 150 mL, adjust pH 7.5 with HCl, add dH₂O to 200 mL, autoclave, store RT.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.4
steps.instruction: Same as above but adjust pH 7.4 with 15 mL concentrated HCl, autoclave, store RT.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 6.8
steps.instruction: Dissolve 36.33 g Tris base, bring to 200 mL, adjust pH 6.8 with 24 mL HCl, autoclave, store RT.

steps.title: Prepare 4 M NaCl solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 11.69 g NaCl in dH₂O to 50 mL (0.234 g/mL), store RT.

steps.title: Prepare 5 M NaOH solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 g NaOH in dH₂O to 50 mL (0.2 g/mL), store RT.

steps.title: Prepare 1.5 M CaCl₂ solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 11.03 g CaCl₂·2H₂O in dH₂O to 50 mL (0.22 g/mL), store RT.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M MnCl₂ solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 9.9 g MnCl₂·4H₂O in dH₂O to 50 mL (0.2 g/mL), store RT.

steps.title: Prepare 2.5 M KCl solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 9.32 g KCl in dH₂O to 50 mL (0.19 g/mL), store RT.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M MgSO₄ solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 12.3 g MgSO₄·7H₂O in dH₂O to 50 mL (0.246 g/mL), filter‑sterilize, store 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M Maltose solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 9 g D(+)-Maltose monohydrate in dH₂O to 50 mL (0.18 g/mL), filter‑sterilize, store 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M Sodium citrate solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 14.7 g Na₃C₆H₅O₇·2H₂O in dH₂O to 50 mL (0.29 g/mL), store RT.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M IPTG solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 12 g IPTG in dH₂O to 50 mL (0.24 g/mL), filter‑sterilize, aliquot 10 mL, store –20 °C (stable ≥1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare 1 M DTT solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.54 g DTT in dH₂O to 10 mL (0.154 g/mL), aliquot 1 mL, store –20 °C (stable ≥1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare 1000× Ampicillin stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 g Ampicillin (100 mg/mL) in 25 mL 50 % ethanol, add 25 mL dH₂O, filter‑sterilize, aliquot 500 µL, store –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 40 % glucose stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 20 g glucose in dH₂O to 50 mL, autoclave 121 °C 15 min, store RT.

steps.title: Prepare 10 % SDS stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 g SDS in dH₂O to 50 mL, store RT.

steps.title: Prepare 10 % APS stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.2 g APS in dH₂O to 2 mL, store RT.

steps.title: Make 4× Loading buffer (SLB)
steps.instruction: Prepare 10 mL 4× SLB: 4 mL 10 % SDS (v/v), 2 mL 20 % glycerol, 0.4 mg bromophenol blue, 1.25 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 6.8, 0.5 mL 5 % β‑mercaptoethanol, 2.75 mL dH₂O; store –20 °C, warm before use, add 100 µL β‑mercaptoethanol to 900 µL before use.

steps.title: Make 1× Electrode buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 L Tris‑Glycine/SDS buffer (25 mM Tris‑base, 190 mM Glycine, 0.1 % SDS).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 3.03 g Tris‑base, 14.4 g Glycine, 1 g SDS in dH₂O, bring to 1 L, store RT.

steps.title: Prepare 30 % Acrylamide/Bis‑acrylamide
steps.instruction: Dissolve 14.5 g Acrylamide (29 % w/v) and 0.5 g Bis‑acrylamide (1 % w/v) in dH₂O to 50 mL, filter‑sterilize (0.45 µm).

steps.title: Make Resolving gel buffer pH 8.8
steps.instruction: Dissolve 36.3 g Tris‑base in dH₂O, adjust to pH 8.8 with HCl, bring to 200 mL, store RT.

steps.title: Make Stacking gel buffer pH 6.8
steps.instruction: Dissolve 3.025 g Tris‑base in dH₂O, adjust to pH 6.8 with HCl, bring to 50 mL, store RT.

steps.title: Prepare 20 % PEG 8000 solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.4 g PEG 8000 in 2 mL 20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.4, store –20 °C ≤2 months.

steps.title: Transform BL21(DE3) with expression plasmid
steps.instruction: Introduce pMAL_Treacle 2× LCR into fresh BL21(DE3) cells and plate on LB‑glucose‑ampicillin plates.

substeps.instruction: Grow BL21 from a fresh LB plate; transfer a single colony into 1 mL Terrific Broth, incubate 37 °C, 600 × g, 1–1.5 h to OD₆₀₀ 0.1–0.3.
Pellet at 2,300 × g 5 min 4 °C, keep on ice.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL TB buffer, incubate on ice 10 min.
Pellet at 6,000 × g 30 s 4 °C, resuspend in 70 µL TB buffer.
Add 1 µg plasmid, incubate on ice 30 min.
Heat‑shock 42 °C 2 min, return to ice 1 min.
Optional: add 1 mL TB, shake 37 °C 600 rpm 1 h (only for non‑ampicillin resistance).
Plate 100–900 µL on LB‑glucose‑ampicillin plates (100 µg/mL), spread, incubate 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Small‑scale expression and pull‑down
steps.instruction: Express peptide in 10–20 colonies, harvest, lyse, and capture on amylose resin.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 1 mL TB with 10–20 colonies, transfer to 50 mL TB + 100 µg/mL ampicillin, grow 37 °C 200 × g to OD₆₀₀ 1–1.5.
Cool, take 250 µL pre‑induction sample, pellet 5,000 × g 5 min 4 °C, resuspend in 25 µL start buffer, store –20 °C (Aliquot #0).
Add 50 µL 1 M IPTG (final 1 mM), incubate overnight 18 °C 250 × g.
Next day, pellet cells 3,200 × g 20 min 4 °C, resuspend pellet in 2 mL start buffer.
Take 250 µL post‑induction sample, pellet 5,000 × g 5 min 4 °C, resuspend in 25 µL start buffer, store –20 °C (Aliquot #1).
Sonicate on ice: pre‑cool 5 min, 5 × (20 s on, 2 min off) at 50 % amplitude.
Clear lysate 16,000 × g 20 min 4 °C, keep supernatant on ice.
Equilibrate 50 µL amylose resin in 1 mL start buffer, 5 min 4 °C; pellet resin 1,000 × g 1 min 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Incubate lysate with resin 20 × g 10 min 4 °C (rotor), pellet resin 1,000 × g 1 min 4 °C, discard flow‑through.
Wash resin 3 × 1 mL wash buffer, centrifuge 1,000 × g 1 min 4 °C each.
Elute with 150 µL elution buffer + 50 µL 4× SLB, boil 5 min.
Pellet resin 1,000 × g 1 min 4 °C, collect supernatant, store –20 °C (Aliquot #2, 25 µL).
Thaw Aliquots #0 and #1, add 9 µL 4× SLB, boil 5 min, store –20 °C.

steps.title: SDS‑PAGE analysis of expression
steps.instruction: Run 10 % resolving / 4 % stacking gels and stain with One‑Step Blue.

substeps.instruction: Cast 10 % resolving gel and 4 % stacking gel using Recipes 34 and 35, employ 1× electrode buffer.
Add 4× SLB to each sample, boil 5 min.
Load 5 µL Aliquot #0, 5 µL Aliquot #1, 20 µL Aliquot #2, and protein ladder.
Run electrophoresis: 20 mA 30 min RT, then 40 mA until dye front reaches bottom.
Stain gel in 100 mL One‑Step Blue Protein Gel Stain 1 h RT (50 × g) or overnight 4 °C.
Rinse twice with 50 mL water, image on transilluminator.

steps.title: Large‑scale peptide expression
steps.instruction: Produce 500 mL culture of recombinant MBP‑Treacle for purification.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1 L Terrific Broth, split into two 500 mL flasks.
Resuspend 20–50 colonies in 1 mL TB, inoculate 500 µL into 500 mL TB + 100 µg/mL ampicillin, grow 37 °C 220 × g to OD₆₀₀ 1–1.5.
Cool, take 250 µL pre‑induction sample (store –20 °C).
Add 500 µL 1 M IPTG (final 1 mM), incubate overnight 18 °C 220 × g.
Next day, take 250 µL post‑induction sample (store –20 °C).
Harvest cells: centrifuge 5,000 × g 20 min 4 °C, discard supernatant, repeat with remaining culture.
Resuspend pellet in 10 mL ice‑cold start buffer (500 mL culture per 10 mL buffer).
Incubate on ice 5 min, sonicate (pre‑cool 5 min, 5 × 20 s on/2 min off at 50 % then 5 × 20 s on/2 min off at 100 %).
Clarify lysate 20,000 × g 60 min 4 °C, keep supernatant on ice.

steps.title: Affinity purification on amylose column
steps.instruction: Bind MBP‑fusion to amylose resin, wash, and elute peptide with TEV cleavage.

substeps.instruction: Pack 12 mL amylose gravity column, equilibrate with 10 column volumes start buffer at 4 °C.
Load cleared lysate, allow to flow through.
Wash column >10 column volumes wash buffer.
Add 5 mL maltose‑free elution buffer containing 5 mM sodium citrate and 1 mL (≈1,000 U) TEV protease (1 U cleaves 2 µg MBP‑fusion).
Incubate column sealed in 50 mL Falcon tube, rotate 20 × g 4 °C overnight.
Collect flow‑through, add another 5 mL same buffer, combine fractions, keep on ice.
Elute residual MBP with 10 mL elution buffer containing maltose.
Transfer 10 mL peptide‑containing fraction to 10 kDa SnakeSkin dialysis tubing, dialyze against 1 L 20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.4 overnight 150 × g 4 °C with stirring.

steps.title: Post‑dialysis clarification
steps.instruction: Clarify dialyzed peptide solution and take input aliquot.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge dialysis bag contents 13,000 × g 10 min 4 °C.
Collect 20 µL (Aliquot #0, Input) and store –20 °C.

steps.title: Ion‑exchange chromatography (MonoQ)
steps.instruction: Separate peptide from MBP using anion‑exchange MonoQ 5/50 GL.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate column with 5–10 column volumes Buffer A (20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5).
Load dialyzed sample, collect flow‑through.
Wash >10 column volumes Buffer A.
Elute with linear 50–500 mM NaCl gradient over 30 column volumes (0.5–1 mL/min), collect 0.75 mL fractions #1–12.
Analyze fractions by SDS‑PAGE (prepare 15 % resolving / 4 % stacking gels as in step 39).
Pool fraction #9 (peak peptide), dialyze against 20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.4 at 4 °C overnight (3–4 mL volume).

steps.title: Final concentration and storage
steps.instruction: Remove aggregates, concentrate peptide, quantify, and store.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge pooled fraction 13,000 × g 10 min 4 °C.
Load onto 10 kDa Amicon Ultra filter, centrifuge 5,000 × g 10–20 min 4 °C to ~1 mL.
Measure protein concentration with Qubit Protein BR Assay kit (per manufacturer).
Aliquot concentrated peptide, flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, store –80 °C (avoid repeated freeze‑thaw).

steps.title: In‑vitro condensation assay
steps.instruction: Test phase separation of treacle fragment with PEG 8000 and modulators.

substeps.instruction: Dilute purified peptide in 20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.4 to 0.6–1 mg/mL.
Add PEG 8000 to final 5 % (w/v), incubate RT 10 min.
Place 10 µL of mixture on glass slide, cover with coverslip, image by DIC microscopy.
For inhibition tests, add 500 mM NaCl or 10 % (v/v) 1,6‑hexanediol to the PEG‑containing mixture before imaging.
